title: Agentic Discovery of Simple Symbolic Inventory Policies
abstract: arXiv:2611.29440v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Designing simple inventory policies becomes increasingly difficult as operational features and system configurations expand. We develop an Agentic Inventory-Policy Discovery System based on explicitly defined simple operational formula (SOF) policy and template classes. Large language models (LLMs) revise symbolic structures, while a numerical engine fits parameters separately for each instance and evaluates the induced policies. Multicriteria parent selection, state-specific operational diagnostics, and reusable symbolic motifs guide structural evolution. A three-stage progression develops shared templates across instances and configurations with varying state dimensions. Experiments on 15,600 instances spanning 50 demand distributions cover lead times, perishability, their combination, and lead times with limited customer patience. translated_title: 智能体驱动的简单符号化库存策略发现
translated_abstract: 随着运营特征和系统配置的不断扩展，设计简单的库存策略变得日益困难。我们开发了一个基于明确定义的简单运营公式（SOF）策略和模板类别的智能体库存策略发现系统。大语言模型（LLM）负责修改符号结构，而数值引擎为每个实例单独拟合参数并评估由此产生的策略。多准则父代选择、状态特定的运营诊断以及可复用的符号模体共同引导结构演化。三阶段的演进过程在具有不同状态维度的实例和配置之间发展出共享模板。在覆盖50种需求分布的15,600个实例上开展的实验，涵盖了提前期、易腐性、两者的组合以及顾客耐心有限的提前期等场景。所发现的模板在总体实证表现上优于被评估的SOF基准，并且……
tldr: 该论文提出一个由大语言模型演化符号策略结构、数值引擎负责参数拟合与评估的智能体库存策略发现系统，能在15,600个测试实例上自动发现优于传统简单运营公式（SOF）基准的简单库存策略模板。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an agentic inventory-policy discovery system in which LLMs evolve symbolic policy structures while a numerical engine fits parameters and evaluates policies, discovering simple inventory templates that outperform SOF benchmarks across 15,600 test instances.
